title: Woezel and Pip look for the sun.
lines: Two little dogs live in the Magic Garden.
They're the very best of friends.
Everything is lovely in the Magic Garden.
And there's a big tree where they live in a little house.
Neighbour Cat, who is always asleep.
And Little Mole, who lives under the ground.
One morning Woezel and Pip wake up.
Without the sun the flowers don't open.
Woezel says: Let's go and find the sun!
Owl is sitting in the tree.
Owl, do you know where the sun is?
The sun is behind the clouds.
Woezel and Pip walk to the hill.
On the way they see Little Mole.
He pokes his little nose out of the ground.
Little Mole wants to come too.
I'm under the ground so often.
I want to see the sun too.
At the top of the hill it's quiet.
If we blow really hard, maybe the wind will come too!
They blow so hard that their cheeks puff out.
Then a leaf on a tree starts to move.
The wind blows the clouds aside.
And then, suddenly, a warm ray shines through.
Woezel, Pip and Little Mole roll down the hill.
Everyone in the garden is happy.
She lies purring in the sun.
That evening, when the sun goes down, Woezel and Pip wave.
